verdict.rationale: Pricing per tool call or connection and documented rate limits are a fair question for a hosted MCP integration platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions pricing, plans, per-call or per-connection costs, or rate limits. The 401 API probe shows key-gating only, not usage limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
